cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Make It Official
cards.instruction: Recruit someone by giving them a title, role, or ceremonial duty that makes participation feel binding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I've made you Keeper of the Festival Lantern.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only said I'd hold it while you tied your shoe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. An excellent probationary performance. Here's your badge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Until you find a qualified successor. The lantern must never be abandoned.

mechanism: A turns its former festival pupil brief lantern-holding help into a graded appointment whose exit requires training a successor.
confusable: Not simply thanking a helper or sharing liability: ceremonial title and qualification make participation binding past the temporary favor.
comparison: Imposed lantern office versus negotiated silent patron ceremony.
seedUse: D175 lantern/shoe/probation/badge/successor; S05 hand-position training and pupil succession.
